content:
Apple today released the latest Mac mini and Mac Studio models. Alongside the new product announcements, the company also made small changes to several Magic Keyboard accessories.

The latest Magic Keyboard removes the text labels on keycaps, replacing them with icons only.

Apple's Mac mini and Mac Studio come with more powerful upgrades, including the next-generation M6 chip and other new processors such as the high-end M5 Ultra.

The latest models are now available for pre-order: order the Mac mini here, and order the Mac Studio here.

Beyond the desktop computer improvements, Apple has also updated the Magic Keyboard lineup, with the new versions featuring one subtle change.

The latest Magic Keyboard removes the text labels on multiple keys, replacing them with icons only.

Apple previously made the same change on the MacBook Neo, MacBook Air, and MacBook Pro, and now the Magic Keyboard has received the same update.

Here are the changes to each model of the new Magic Keyboard:

  • Magic Keyboard: US$99
  • Magic Keyboard with Touch ID: US$149
  • Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad: US$179

Commonly used keys such as Tab, Caps Lock, Return, Shift, and Delete no longer display text, showing only icons. On the extended models with a numeric keypad, keys like Home, Page Up, and Page Down have also been given new icons to replace the original text.

Popular comment from Caesarrr

I really don't understand this approach. You know it adds barriers for users — what benefit is worth sacrificing the user experience?

Aside from switching to icons, the new Magic Keyboard looks almost identical to the previous model. All versions support USB-C, with the same features and layout as before.

If you want to order the new Magic Keyboard through Amazon rather than Apple, you can purchase it here: Magic Keyboard, the version with Touch ID, and the version with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad (in black).

What are your thoughts on the removal of keycap text labels? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.
